newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 313 OF DECEMBER 3, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 313 OF DECEMBER 3, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

COMMISSION DECISION of 25 November 1996 laying down special conditions for the import of live bivalve molluscs, echinoderms, tunicates and marine gastropods originating in Chile (Text with EEA relevance) (96/675/EC)

COMMISSION DECISION of 25 November 1996 amending Decision 93/436/EEC laying down specific conditions for importing fishery and aquaculture products originating in Chile (Text with EEA relevance) (96/674/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 22 November 1996 concerning the validity of certain binding tariff information (Only the French and Dutch text are authentic) (96/673/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 22 November 1996 concerning the validity of certain binding tariff information (Only the German text is authentic) (96/672/EC)

COMMISSION DECISION of 13 November 1996 relating to a procedure in application of Article 83 of the Euratom Treaty (XVII-05 - Jenson Tungsten Ltd, Hemel Hempstead) (Only the English text is authentic) (96/671/Euratom)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2314/96 of 2 December 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2313/96 of 2 December 1996 suspending the preferential customs duties and re-establishing the Common Customs Tariff duty on imports of multiflorous (spray) carnations originating in Israel
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2312/96 of 2 December 1996 fixing the definitive aid on certain grain legumes for the 1996/97 marketing year
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2311/96 of 2 December 1996 amending Regulation (EEC) No 3886/92 laying down detailed rules for the application of premium schemes in the beef and veal sector

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2310/96 of 2 December 1996 amending Council Regulation (EEC) No 1101/89 in respect of the conditions applying to the placing in service of new pusher-craft capacity on inland waterways
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 2309/96 of 2 December 1996 on the supply of cereals as food aid END OF DOCUMENT.
